relationships.subject: DHEA-S
relationships.evidence_quote: DHEA-S is a neurosteroid functioning as a neurotropin, that can bind and activate nerve growth factor (NGF) and brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF)21,22.

relationships.subject: ESR1
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition to the role of ESR1 in the sex hormone pathway, it also regulates expression of COMT which encodes for a key enzyme (catechol-O-methyltransferase)

relationships.subject: endometriosis
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed significant genetic correlations between endometriosis and 11 pain conditions, including migraine, back and multisite chronic pain (MCP)

key_findings: GWAS meta-analysis identified 42 loci (49 signals) for endometriosis, with several loci (NGF, GDAP1, SRP14/BMF, BSN, MLLT10) linked to pain.
Significant genetic correlation between endometriosis and 11 pain conditions and inflammatory conditions (asthma, osteoarthritis).
